title: Chevening Master's Scholarships
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Monthly Living Allowance, Airfare)
description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in any subject at any UK university.

title: Software Engineering Internship 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Experience in Data Structures, Algorithms, C++, Java, or Python
description: Join Google for a 12-14 week summer internship where you will work on real-world projects and solve complex technical challenges alongside full-time engineers.

title: Junior Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with up to 2 years of experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
description: Work across Microsoft Azure and Developer Tools teams to build reliable, scalable cloud backend services using C#, C++, or TypeScript.

title: Associate Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide willing to work in distributed teams
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, Vue.js/React, HTML5, CSS3, and open-source contribution experience
description: Help build and maintain open-source UI infrastructure for Wikipedia and brother free-knowledge projects, focusing on accessibility and performance.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Global Student Contest
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university worldwide
qualification: Team of 1 to 4 students submitting an innovative tech project using Microsoft Cloud/AI
description: The Imagine Cup is Microsoft's premier global competition for student developers, offering mentorship, funding, and global recognition for impactful AI/tech solutions.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with internet access
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving. Covers C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with practical homework assignments.
